events.title: Within 24 hours of his latest dismissal and reinstatement at 바닛, Barry Fry finally leaves the troubled North London club to succeed Colin Murphy as manager of 사우스엔드 유나이티드. Fry's assistant Edwin Stein agrees to take charge of the club for the remainder of the season, but makes it clear that he will not continue as manager beyond that.

셰필드 웬즈데이 reach their first FA Cup final in 27 years as they defeat 셰필드 유나이티드 2–1 at Wembley with goals from Mark Bright and 크리스 워들 . United's consolation goal came from Alan Cork . The two teams are led out by 셰필드 유나이티드's cancer-stricken goalkeeper Mel Rees . Oldham climb out of the relegation zone with a 6–2 home win over 윔블던, while 미들즈브러 remain bottom of the table after crashing to a 4–0 defeat at 첼시. 블랙번 로버스 keep their faint title hopes alive with a 4–1 home win over 리버풀.

아스널 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 meet in the FA Cup semi-finals for the second time in three seasons. 아스널 win 1–0, with captain 토니 애덤스 scoring the only goal of the match. 애스턴 빌라 return to the top of the Premier League with a 1–0 away win over 노팅엄 포리스트, who miss the chance to climb out of the relegation zone.

In a crucial match in the title run-in, 맨체스터 유나이티드 win 3–1 against 노리치 시티 at Carrow Road with goals from 에리크 캉토나 , 라이언 긱스 and 안드레이 칸첼스키스 in the first half, with former United striker Mark Robins later reducing 노리치 시티's deficit. United are now one point behind leaders 애스턴 빌라 with six games left to play.
미들즈브러 boost their survival hopes with a 1–0 home win over 아스널, as do 셰필드 유나이티드 with a 2–1 home win over Leeds.
블랙번 로버스's recent surge continues with a 3–1 away win over 노팅엄 포리스트, as the hosts drop another three points in their bid to avoid relegation.
노리치 시티's Premier League title hopes are further damaged by a 5–1 defeat at 토트넘 홋스퍼.

Centre-back 스티브 브루스 scores two late goals to give 맨체스터 유나이티드 a 2–1 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이, putting them top of the table by a point with five games remaining as 애스턴 빌라 are held to a goalless draw at home by Coventry. A 4–3 defeat to QPR at Loftus Road pushes 노팅엄 포리스트 closer to relegation.

Trailing 버밍엄 시티 1–4 after 60 minutes, 스윈던 타운 score five goals in 30 minutes to win 6–4. The Premier League title race sees the top four teams all win. 미들즈브러 slide closer to relegation with a 4–1 defeat at 크리스털 팰리스, while a 2–1 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼 keeps 노팅엄 포리스트's survival hopes alive. 이언 러시 continues his return to form with his seventh league goal in eight matches as 리버풀 draw 1–1 with 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road .
20-year-old striker Chris Sutton scores a hat-trick for 노리치 시티 as a 4–2 home win over Leeds keeps their title hopes alive.

Midfielder Mark Walters scores a hat-trick as 리버풀 beat 코번트리 시티 4–0 in the Premier League at Anfield . 맨체스터 유나이티드 remain in pole position with a 3–0 home win over 첼시, which puts the title mathematically beyond 블랙번 로버스's reach despite a 3–1 win at 셰필드 유나이티드. 리버풀's improvement in form continues with a 4–0 home win over Coventry.

아스널 beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 2–1 in the League Cup final. Steve Morrow , the scorer of 아스널's winning goal, breaks his arm in a freak accident during the on-pitch celebrations and would likely miss next month's FA Cup final between the same two teams.
노리치 시티's 3–1 defeat at 입스위치 타운 ends their title hopes.
미들즈브러 pick up another three valuable points in their bid for Premier League survival, beating 토트넘 홋스퍼 3–0 at Ayresome Park.

More midweek drama in the Premier League sees 맨체스터 유나이티드 go four points clear with two games remaining by beating 크리스털 팰리스 2–0 at Selhurst Park, as 애스턴 빌라 lose 3–0 to 블랙번 로버스 at Ewood Park. 리버풀 climb to fifth place with a 2–0 home win over Leeds.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드 drop off the top of Division One for the first time since September, as new leaders 포츠머스 beat 울버햄프턴 원더러스 2–0 at Fratton Park . However, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are still just one point behind with two games in hand.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 make a quick return to the top of Division One with a 1–0 home win over 선덜랜드, and now need just two points from their final three games to be sure of promotion.
브라이언 클러프 announces that he will retire as 노팅엄 포리스트 manager at the end of the season after 18 years in charge.
A Zambian Air Force aircraft carrying most of the Zambia national football team crashes off Libreville , Gabon , killing all 30 people on board.
England and the Netherlands draw 2–2 at Wembley in their World Cup qualifier. 스토크 시티 clinch the Division Two title.

Former 찰턴 애슬레틱 defender Tommy Caton dies at his home in Oxfordshire at age 30 after suffering a heart attack, just weeks after retiring from playing following a two-year absence due to injury. As April draws to a close, 맨체스터 유나이티드 are four points ahead of 애스턴 빌라 in the league with two matches remaining. The Division One promotion race is still wide open, with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 still top and needing just two points from their final three matches to seal promotion. 포츠머스 occupy second place and need four points from their final two matches to get promoted, but 웨스트햄 유나이티드 could still overtake them if they managed at least one win and a draw from their next two games. 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 스윈던 타운, 레스터 시티 and 트랜미어 로버스 complete the top six. 밀월 are now the only team who can prevent the Wirral side from finishing in the play-off zone and maintaining their challenge to get into the Premier League. 브리스틀 로버스 are mathematically relegated, needing a minimum of ten points as well as a 21-goal swing between them and 21st-placed 선덜랜드 from the remaining two matches, but Cambridge and 브렌트퍼드 are more optimistic of avoiding the drop.
